data.description: Completion-side attestation reuse is ALREADY identity-scoped by construction: _reusable_attested_pass reuses only a cert where verify_signature(kind=completion-verifier) returns verified+opcert, and verify_opcert_record certifies only when record.principal == own_principal AND the DSSE signature verifies under this environment's own key (a foreign/local-dev cert is rejected). So this slice is (1) explicit TEST COVERAGE pinning that identity-scoping invariant (a local-dev cert is rejected by the AWS bot and vice-versa), (2) documentation of the guarantee, and (3) the shared reuse SEAM (vaquita AC#3) factored so the future code-review reuse can share it. Does NOT change the trust model. If the ADR (refutable-meaningful-borzoi) picks a different identity notion than env_id/principal, fold that in. Independently verifiable: tests + docs only.
data.title: Completion-verifier attestation reuse: identity-scoping test coverage + shared reuse seam
